content: Maigan-akwed-igar
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “We-Igarmar Israel-dulemarga be ukoed:
‘Be Hebreo-dule-mai baksale, unnila, bega birganergwa-arbaega (6) be imakoed. Birgagugledgi (7) be ollor-imakoed. We-dule, e-arbasadgi, bipisaale gwen bennuklegosulid.
” ’We-mai-baklesadi, bese omesuli nonikile, walagwen gannar naoed. Ar bese ome-nika-nonikile, e-omebo gannar naoed.
” ’Mai-e-ibed e-maiga ome-uksale, ome ega machimala-baksale, bunamala-baksardibe, ome, degi, e-mimmigan, e-mai-ibedgadga guoed. Maidina, walagwen gannar naoed.
” ’Ar mai, na e-ibed-sabedbali, na e-ome-sabedbali, degi, na e-mimmigan-sabedbali, sogele, an yapa naye,
ar adi, e-ibed, dummagan-igar-nabomaladse e-mai-sedoed Geb yawagaksedibe, yawagak-dikarsedibe, sedoed. Agi esgoro-swichwigwadgi e-uaya udgoed. Geb agi, a-dule ibed-e-maiga degisadegu gunonisunnoed.
” ’Ar dule-wargwen na e-bunagwa maiga-guega manigi uksale, we-bunagwa-ollor-imaklegega, mai-macherganyob imaklegosulid.
” ’Dule-wargwen-bunagwa-baksad eginsur-bunagwa-dakele, nikubisulile, sunna Israel-dule-baid nabir manigi bunagwa-onogega imakoed. Nikubisurgussoggu, bipisaagwale, Israel-dulesulidga manigi ukosulid.
” ’Dule bunagwa-baksadi, e-machi-ebo-nikuega ega ukele, na e-sisgwayob we-bunagwa-sedii guoed.
” ’Dule bunagwa-maiga-baksadi, a-bunagwa-nikusale, a-sorba, geb ome-baid-nikunonibalile, we-bunagwa-idualedga:

content.text: Mas-ega-uklegedi, amba deyob ega ukdii guoed.
Mor-ega-uklegedi, amba deyob ega ukdii gubaloed.
Degine, amba ebo gudiidgine, ese gordii gubaloed.

content: ” ’Ar e-sui bunagwaga we-ibmar-sogbaagwad imaksulile, bunagwa sunna na e-itolegedba nabier naoed. Onolegega, bipisaale dule-baid we-bunagwa-anar bennukosulid, maniginsuli binsa na e-itolegedba nooed.’ ”
Apor-imakmalad-Igar
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Dule-wargwen dule-baid-sabsur-naibisasadba oburgwisar, we-dule, oburgwilegoed.
”Ar dule-emar-oburgwisad yamo-imaksasulile, Bab-Dummad-sogedba burgwisale, we-dule, bega an neg-sorba-sogoedse, dukunaoed.
”Ar dule, sae-itogedba dule-baid-oburgwisale, anga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailase dukunadele, we-dule, amba be sunaedsegad, degine, oburgwilegoed.
”Dule e-bab-naibisasale, e-nan-naibisasdibe, we-dule, oburgwilegoed.
”Dule, dule-baid-gasale, dule-baidga manigi dule-galesad-uksale, igidibe, amba e-walik-gales-sii daklesdibe, we-dule-emar-gasad oburgwilegoed.
”Dule e-bab-ukabsasale, e-nan-ukabsasale, we-dule, oburgwilegoed.
”Na ebo-urwenaidgi, dule akwagi-makar dule-baid-naibisasale, igidibe, argangi sabsur-sarsosadgi naibisasdibe, oburgwissulile, ar gasgindi mesisale,

we-dule-naibigusad suar-gaapoledgi nabir nanagusardina, geb agi soglegoed, we-emar-naibi-imaksadi oburgwilegosurye, baisurye. Deyob soglego-inigwele, dule-emar-naibi-imaksad, bela ega inadi bennukoed, degine, arbassulid-nukad bela bennukbaloed.
”Dule suargi na e-mai-machered-sarsosale, e-mai-ome-sarsosdibe, degidba oburgwisale, we-dule sabsur-odurdaklegoed.
Ar e-mai-sarsolesad, ibagwenadgi, ibabogindibe, nabir ugakgusale, we-mai, e-ibedgadsoggu, e-ibed sabsur-odurdaklegosulid.

”Machergan urwenanaidgi ome-gurgin-nikad-naibisasale, ei igarba-mellegega imaksale, ar omedi dogdar akar-gussulile, e-sui igi-mani egi gadagoedba, dule-ome-sarsosad deyob bennukergebed. Dulemar-ega-igar-nabomalad e-sui-mani-nug-egisnaid nabir-itomalale, deyob imaklegoed.
”Ar ome apor-naibigusardi, weyob imaklegoed: Ome-burgwisar, dule oburgwilemogoed.

Dule, ome-ibe ibya-nailik naibisasale, ibya-nailik ei naibisalemogoed. Dule, ome-ibe nugar-gagwen bichisalnugar-gagwen ei bichilemogoed. Dule, ome-ibe argan-nailik naibisasale, argan-nailik ei naibisalemogoed. Dule, ome-ibe nag-wargwen naibisasale, nag-wargwen ei naibisalemogoed.
Dule ome-ogumaksale, ogumaklemogoed. Dule, ome-naibisasale, deyob naibisalemogoed. Dule, ome-sarsosale, deyob sarsolemogoed.
”Dule na e-mai-machered ibyagi-sarsosale, e-mai-omegwa-ibyagi-sarsosdibe, ei ibya onosale, e-ibed ei-ibya-gwagwen-onosad-ular, e-mai-ollor-imakoed.
”Ei nugar-gagwen-bichisale, e-ibed ei-nugar-bichisad-ular, e-mai-ollor-imakoed.”
Binsa nabir naibigumalad-Igar
“Moli-bebe-nikad-machered dule-macheredgi-yolesale, omegindibe, degidba, dule-oburgwisale, we-moli, akwagi-makar oburgwilegoed. E-san, gullegosulid. Moli-e-ibeddi oakalolegosulid.

”Ar moli-ibed bato wisilegusgu moli-bebe-nikad-machered dulemargi-yoledigua, degine, e-ibed gwen edichasuli, we-moli dulegi yolesdibe, dule-oburgwisale, we-moli akwagi-makar oburgwilegoed. Geb moli-ibed, akwagi-makar oburgwilemogoed.
”Degi-inigwele, moli-bebe-nikad-ibed na san-bendakegala, mer oburgwilegega, egi-mani-galegoed, bennukoed.
”Moli-bebe-nikad machi-gwensakgi-yolesdibe, bunolo-gwensakgindibe, amba we-igar-maidba imaklegoed.
”Ar moli-bebe-nikad-machered mai-macheredgi yolesdibe, mai-omegindibe, we-moli, akwagi-makar oburgwilegoed. Degine, moli-ibed mani-gwadulagwen-gakambe (30) mai-ibed-bennukoed.
”Dule-wargwen dia egaar sisale, igidibe, yaa-dummad dii-sigega akwisdibe, a-yaa edissuli sisale, agi moli-bebe-nikad-alugwasualed argwachale, moli-uayasuid-argwachadibe,
dia-ibed moli-ibed-bennukoed, geb degi, ibmar-dula-burgwisad suoed.
”Moli-bebe-nikad-wargwen baid-moli-bebe-nikad-machered-oburgwisdibe, moli-dulad manigi uklegoed, we-mani na ebo negabar mimioed, degine, moli-burgwisad-e-san negabar mimimarbaloed.

”Ar dule wisirdi, we-moli-bebe-nikad-machered gadi-urwe, degite, e-ibed moli-gwen-edichasuli, moli-gadi-urwed-ibed, moli-bebe-nikad-machered-burgwisad-ibedga moli-bebe-nikad-machered-dulad ega wargwen ukoed. Moli-gadi-urwed-ibed, moli-burgwisaddi susunnoed.”
